reviews.review:
Third ME set a high bar for the series, with its lesbian shower scenes and some interesting characters. Obviously, the new team of Bioware couldn't pull it off... But here you can re-educate a homosexual. And this is not a joke.
 This game has nothing in common with Mass Effect. A mediocre plot, character animations (especially faces), animations of the ship moving from planet to planet, loot mechanics and endless spawning of enemies, what kind of a sandbox of soulless characters is this, is this a Destiny game? NO, THIS IS NEW GAME FROM BIOWARE...
 The only beautiful character in the game is Suvi Anvar, only if you play as a man who also can't joke and his lines in dialogues only cause cringe, you will not be able to hook up with her. You have to play as a woman, oh, how modern it is... (no).
 The game has nothing to grab onto, even the crafting system for weapons and other equipment is stuffy and uninteresting. The scan mechanics artificially increase the passage of the game by tens of hours, as well as enemies constantly appearing out of nowhere.
 This piece of junk belongs next to Mafia 3 and "games" from Ubisoft, but not near Mass Effect 1-2

Far from the failure that the community paints it to be in my opinion. I really enjoyed it! Loved the Angara! Hope to see more of them in future projects!

This game has no soul.

The main cast of characters are not likeable. The dialogue is jarring and continuously prevents you from getting immersed. The bullet sponge enemies on higher difficulty is ass. Just stick with the original trilogy imo.

Also, the majority of the armour designs are ugly.
Still a better game than Veilguard
Meh. I Spent more time in menus and figuring out where is what then i spent playing. Got bored of the game after some time.
